item.title: Müller and Maloney each score a goal, Fleet hand Sceptres 4th straight loss, 2-1
item.description: LOWELL, Mass. (AP) — Alina Müller had a goal and an assist, Shay Maloney also scored a goal, and the Boston Fleet beat the Toronto Sceptres 2-1 on Wednesday night at the Tsongas Center.

item.title: Press freedom advocates worry that raid on Washington Post journalist's home will chill reporting
item.description: If the byproduct of Wednesday's raid on a Washington Post journalist's home is to deter probing reporting of government action, the Trump administration could hardly have chosen a more compelling target.

item.title: Canada's Marina Stakusic, Liam Draxl through to main draw at Australian Open
item.description: MELBOURNE — Canada's Marina Stakusic and Liam Draxl have earned their spots in the main draw at the Australian Open. Stakusic, from Mississauga, Ont., advanced with a 7-5, 6-4 win over Lin Zhu of China in the final round of qualifying Thursday.

item.title: Voting begins in Uganda’s presidential election during internet shutdown and polling station delays
item.description: KAMPALA, Uganda (AP) — Voting began Thursday in Uganda’s presidential election despite a days-long internet shutdown that has been criticized as an anti-democratic gesture in a country where the president has held office since 1986.

item.title: College instructor, a mother of two, allegedly killed by ex-partner in Saanich
item.description: Muhammed Ali Basar has been charged with second-degree murder in the death of Laura Gover-Basar.

item.title: B.C. won't extend its drug decriminalization experiment, health minister says
item.description: “Despite the hard work and good intentions behind the pilot, it has not delivered the results we hoped for,” says Health Minister Josie Osborne.
